Before starting, have these ready: personal details (including date of birth and nationality), mobile number, a valid and active email ID, reservation category details (if any), and the percentage of each qualification from Matriculation onwards. Convert any CGPA/SGPA to a percentage in advance.

Keep a copy of everything you send.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Appointed candidates will be paid according to the pay scales prescribed by the UGC and/or the Government of Punjab, as amended from time to time. The notice does not give post-wise pay levels or allowances. Probation: Appointments on a regular basis will have a three-year probation period, as per Punjab Government Notification no. G.S.R.56/Const./Art.309/Amd.(18)/2016, dated 5 September 2016. Deputation: A person may be appointed on deputation basis from State/Central Government Institutions/Universities. Contract post: The notice lists the Law Researcher post as "On Contract". It does not mention a contract length. Verification: The university will verify the antecedents and documents of candidates at the time of appointment or at any time during their service. Services will be terminated at once if the documents are found to be fake, or if a candidate has a clandestine background and has hidden it.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes how candidates are selected for three posts: Assistant Professor, Superintendent and Senior Assistant. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview using the Academic Score in Appendix II (Table 3A) of the UGC Regulations 2018. The Academic Score is used for shortlisting only. Selection is based only on performance in the interview. The university decides how many candidates are called for the interview. The score caps are: M.Phil + Ph.D. 30 marks, JRF/NET/SET 07 marks and awards 03 marks. Teaching or post-doctoral experience of less than one year earns proportionately fewer marks. The 100 marks are made up of Academic Score 80, Research Publications 10 and Teaching Experience 10. All mandatory fields in the online form must be filled, especially the Academic/Research Scores. To calculate the score, use the method for calculating the Academic/Research Score for Assistant Professor posts under the UGC Regulations 2018. No changes are allowed after submission. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted through a competitive test. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Candidates must pass typing tests in Punjabi (in Unicode Font Raavi) and English, held by the university, at a speed of 30 wpm (300 words in 10 minutes). Eligible candidates are shortlisted through these typing tests. Those who pass then take a skill test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PSOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 2 Assistant Professor (History and Public Administration), 1 Assistant Registrar, 2 Superintendent, 1 System Administrator, 1 Programmer, 2 Senior Assistant and 1 Law Researcher (On Contract).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PSOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to register and submit the online application is 15 November 2026. The hard copy with supporting documents must reach the Registrar by 5:00 pm on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for PSOU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject plus NET/SLET/SET (or a Ph.D. that gives exemption under the UGC Regulations). The alternative is a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 by QS, THE or ARWU. Punjabi up to Matric Standard is essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for PSOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per UGC/Punjab Govt. Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PSOU posts?
faq.answer: Appointed candidates will be paid according to the pay scales prescribed by the UGC and/or the Government of Punjab, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PSOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2000/- plus 18% GST for General Category and Rs. 1000/- plus 18% GST for SC/ST and PWD candidates, paid online and non-refundable. SC/ST and PWD candidates not domiciled in Punjab pay the General Category fee.

faq.question: Q7. How is the PSOU Assistant Professor selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for the interview by the Academic Score in Appendix II (Table 3A) of the UGC Regulations 2018, out of 100. Selection is based only on performance in the interview.

faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must pass Punjabi (Unicode Font Raavi) and English typing tests at 30 wpm (300 words in 10 minutes). Those who pass then take a skill test.

faq.answer: Yes. Persons already in service must forward their application through proper channel and produce an NOC from their employer at the time of the interview.
